title: OSF Animation
description: Animation playback, scene runtime, and diagnostics. Playback keys are active only while a running scene grants that control.

Scenes - Scene gear.label: Auto-equip scene gear
Scenes - Scene gear.hint: Equip registered gear (belts, props, etc...) carried by scene participants for the scene's duration. Register items via *.osfgear.json files.
